## Summary
- Rule available since: `v2.6.5`
- Diagnostic Category: [`lint/nursery/noVueTextareaMustache`](/reference/diagnostics#diagnostic-category)
- This rule doesn't have a fix.
- The default severity of this rule is [**error**](/reference/diagnostics#error).
- This rule belongs to the following domains:
  - [`vue`](/linter/domains#vue)
- Sources: 
  - Same as [`vue/no-textarea-mustache`](https://eslint.vuejs.org/rules/no-textarea-mustache)

## How to configure
```json title="biome.json"
{
	"linter": {
		"rules": {
			"nursery": {
				"noVueTextareaMustache": "error"
			}
		}
	}
}

```
## Description
Disallow `{{ }}` text interpolation inside a Vue `<textarea>`.

In most elements, Vue replaces `{{ expression }}` with the value of the expression.
Vue doesn't support this inside a `<textarea>`. To show a value in a textarea and keep
it up to date, bind it with `v-model` instead.

Vue doesn't process `{{ }}` inside an element that has `v-pre`, or inside its children,
so the rule ignores those textareas.

## Examples

### Invalid

```vue
<template>
  <textarea>{{ message }}</textarea>
</template>
```

### Valid

```vue
<template>
  <textarea v-model="message"></textarea>
  <textarea v-pre>{{ message }}</textarea>
</template>
```
